Name: Vyranity's Jams and Pies JA
Author: vyranity
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]This mod adds:[/size]
[list]
[*]23 new kinds of pie with a unique look to all of them.
[*]23 new kinds of jam.
[*]3 different new machines.
[/list]
[size=5]The items:[/size]
Alle the kinds of jam are obtainable with the fruit smasher and the modern fruit smasher machine.
To create the jam you need one kind of fruit and one sugar.
All the kinds of pie are obtainable with the Pie Oven.
To create the pie you need one kind of jam combined with one flour.

[size=5]Translations:
[/size]Thanks a lot to[color=#00ffff] [/color][color=#a4c2f4]wally232[/color] for making the Korean translation possible!
Thanks a lot to [color=#a4c2f4]Reid[/color] for making the Chinese translation possible!
Thanks a lot to [color=#a4c2f4]szeel (6squad)[/color] for making the Russian translation possible!

[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]The future of this mod
[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod will get an update in the near future.
In this update I will:
- Redo some of the colouring on the sprites.
- Add some more translations.
- Make it so you can just craft the pies using the kitchen (similarly to my new mod (cakes and creams))
- Flip all of the textures vertically so they face the right way.
- Possibly add some more pies?

[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]What you can do to make this mod better[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]I always have a hard time with balancing so if you have suggestions for better prices, please let me know[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]If you think one of the items looks weird or bad in any way or form, don't be scared to let me know. Feedback is key and without it I can't make this mod better.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]If you really like this mod you can help me translate it. It helps other people of your language and me out. Please do however let me know if you want to translate the mod, because if I can integrate the translation directly into the mod that can really help me out.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]If you have any creative ideas on new items or something, you can of course also let me know.[/size][/font]
[/list]
